title: Bisognano–Wichmann Covariance for Standard-Subspace Nets
exact_target: Can a local standard-subspace net be given another positive-energy Poincaré action whose boosts agree with its wedge modular groups?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002835 (OWR-13673-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Subfactors and Conformal Field Theory (2015), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2015/16, pp. 849--926. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 10.
Morinelli, sufficient conditions (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).
Covariant homogeneous standard-subspace nets (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The new representation must act on the same Hilbert space and preserve covariance of the same net. Wedge subspaces are obtained from the double-cone net by the source\textquotesingle s closure convention; replacing the net is not an answer.
